To run only the fast tests, skip the integration tests marked `postgres`:

```sh
pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

This works whether or not the justfile is there. The full suite (`just test`, or plain `pytest -q`) still needs a database, so run `docker compose up db` first.

However, this checkout doesn't match what you described. On `main` at `49df143`, the `Makefile` is still here and there's no `justfile`. The Makefile has `test-fast` (the command above) and `test` targets. So I can't tell you the name of a fast-test recipe in just, because I can't see one. Maybe the justfile change hasn't been merged or pulled yet. If the justfile doesn't have a fast-test recipe, you could add one like this:

```just

    pytest -m "not postgres" -q

test:
    pytest -q
```

The project memory still says to use `make test-fast`, so I've flagged it as out of date. Once the justfile is in this repo, I can update the memory to the real recipe names.
